subject: Proposal: multi-year ladder + usage-triggered uplift & auto-align window
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Pat Nguyen <pat.nguyen@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Proposal: multi-year ladder + usage-triggered uplift & auto-align window

Hi Pat —

Thanks again for the time last week. Based on our conversation and your growth projections, attached is a clean proposal that does three things we discussed:

1) Moves ACME onto a 3-year laddered commitment (Year 1/2/3: 50%/75%/120% of current committed units) so you get predictable unit pricing while we scale together.
2) Adds a usage-triggered uplift: if monthly consumption exceeds the committed tier by >25% for two consecutive months, billing transitions to the next tier with a retroactive true-up.
3) Provides an "auto-align window" — a single 30-day period annually where both parties can co-term other Redwood contracts into the same anniversary to simplify renewal cadence.

I've included a sample term schedule (ACME_Renewal_Term_Schedule_v1.xlsx) and a draft SOW that reflects the expanded Dedicated capacity reservation for Q4.

Action items I suggest:
- You and finance review the schedule and uplift triggers (Pat).
- If it looks good, we'll put together a formal amendment and a DocuSign link for signature.

Open questions on our side: any limitations from your procurement team on auto-renew/auto-align language? Happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: ACME_Renewal_Term_Schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Pat Nguyen <pat.nguyen@acme-ai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: multi-year ladder + usage-triggered uplift & auto-align window

Camila —

Thanks for sending this over. A few quick questions from our side before we loop finance:

1) For the usage-triggered uplift, can you confirm whether the true-up is invoiced monthly or quarterly? We prefer quarterly true-ups to align with our internal reporting.
2) On the auto-align window, procurement is okay with a single annual alignment but wants the option to opt-out for a given year with 60 days notice. Will that be acceptable?
3) The Dedicated capacity add in Q4 — can Priyom confirm whether the instance types you propose are compatible with our current VPC setup and KMS?

If we can get those clarified I can fast-track to our finance & legal teams.

Best,
Pat Nguyen
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme AI
pat.nguyen@acme-ai.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Pat Nguyen <pat.nguyen@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: multi-year ladder + usage-triggered uplift & auto-align window

Pat —

Great questions, thanks. Quick answers and next steps: 

1) True-up cadence: we can accommodate a quarterly true-up invoicing cycle — we'll reflect that in the amendment language.

2) Opt-out: yes, the auto-align window can include a one-year opt-out clause with 60 days notice; we'll add that carve-out and track it in the renewal checklist.

3) Priyom, can you weigh in on the Dedicated capacity compatibility (VPC/KMS) and whether any additional network peering or KMS configuration work is needed?

If Priyom confirms compatibility, I'll draft the amendment and pull Marissa in for approval on the multi-year discount levels we discussed.

Thanks,
Camila

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Pat Nguyen <pat.nguyen@acme-ai.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: multi-year ladder + usage-triggered uplift & auto-align window

Hi all —

Quick technical confirmation: the Dedicated capacity profile proposed in the SOW uses NVIDIA A10G-equivalent nodes and supports standard VPC peering and KMS integrations we already run with other customers.

Notes / caveats:
- We'll need one small IAM role change on your side to allow the provisioning API to attach the customer-managed KMS key; I'll share the exact terraform snippet in a follow-up.
- If you plan to move to an internal private deployment later in the agreement term, we should add a brief migration scoping appendix to the SOW now to avoid rework.

From a timeline perspective I estimate provisioning and validation will take 4-6 weeks after contract signature.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: multi-year ladder + usage-triggered uplift & auto-align window

Camila / Karthik —

Reviewed the proposed economics and support uplift. I'm comfortable approving a 12% blended discount across the 3-year ladder assuming the quarterly true-up and the 60-day opt-out on the auto-align window are explicitly captured.

Two requests before we send to ACME legal: 
1) Add a clause limiting retroactive true-up exposure to a single quarter (i.e., we won't retroactively bill beyond the immediately preceding quarter).
2) Add an SLA credit schedule tied to Dedicated capacity latency targets in Q4 (small schedule, standard language).

If you can update the amendment with those items, I'll sign off and Camila can send the DocuSign to ACME.

-Marissa
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
